modernizationPaths.description: Migrate JSP to React SPA with existing Servlet/JEE backend converted to REST APIs. Keep Servlet container (Tomcat), convert servlets to JAX-RS resources, reuse DAO/entity layer. Deploy React build as static resources in WAR.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Converting scriptlet-heavy JSPs to React components; REST API design from action-based servlets; Session-to-JWT auth migration; Stateful servlet session sharing with SPA; Build pipeline for WAR with embedded React

modernizationPaths.description: Replace JSP with Vue.js SPA while retaining JEE backend as REST services. Vue's progressive adoption allows incremental migration. Convert servlets to JAX-RS, reuse DAO/JPA layer. Deploy Vue dist in WAR.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Incremental JSP-to-Vue component migration strategy; REST endpoint parity with servlet forwards/redirects; CSRF protection for Vue forms; Session management bridge; Shared WAR build configuration

modernizationPaths.description: Full Angular SPA with JEE REST backend. Angular's opinionated structure suits enterprise migration. Convert servlets to JAX-RS controllers, keep EJB/CDI if present. Angular CLI build output served as static WAR content.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Steep Angular learning curve for JSP developers; Complete rewrite of view layer; RxJS state management vs session attributes; Complex WAR build with Angular CLI; Type-safe API contracts from dynamic JSP scriptlets

modernizationPaths.description: Full stack modernization to React + Quarkus. Migrate servlets to Quarkus REST endpoints (JAX-RS compatible), JPA/Hibernate for DAOs, native compilation support. Separate deployments: React on CDN/nginx, Quarkus as microservice.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Complete architectural redesign to microservices; Quarkus extension mapping for all JEE APIs; Database connection pool migration (Agroal); Native image compatibility for reflection-heavy DAOs; Separate CI/CD for frontend/backend; Distributed auth (OIDC/Keycloak)

modernizationPaths.description: Modernize to Vue.js frontend with Quarkus backend. Vue's flexibility pairs well with Quarkus dev mode. Migrate servlets to Quarkus REST, use Panache for active record pattern. Independent deployments.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Full stack rewrite with two new frameworks; Quarkus reactive vs blocking DAO migration; Vue 3 Composition API adoption; Cross-origin deployment complexity; Auth system replacement; Testing strategy for decoupled architecture

modernizationPaths.description: Enterprise-grade Angular + Quarkus modernization. Leverage Quarkus dev services for DB, Angular for strict typing. Full microservice architecture with shared OpenAPI contracts. Best for long-term maintainability.
modernizationPaths.keyTechnicalChallenges: Highest complexity: two opinionated frameworks; OpenAPI schema generation from legacy servlets; Angular-Quarkus type sharing; Native compilation constraints; Team upskilling for both; Observability/distributed tracing setup
